title: Isolated ArcCivs LAB village work acceleration and single-parcel reset
assumptions: One lab operator and one selected autonomous physical city at a time. Low/base/high: zero, one or three non-overlapping test periods of 10 minutes in a day; scenarios, not telemetry.

Healthy work timer: 2000 ms baseline, 500 ms minimum/4x mode. Construction material and journal checks, shared native caps, routes, food, sleep and storage remain. Physical work still waits ordinary next-action cooldown. Throughput is bounded by all these, not predicted at 4x.

Paid native placement pacing scenario at 20 TPS: 5 ticks between units before and 2 only for the selected LAB city while active. This is at most 4 versus 10 native units per second, or 2400 versus 6000 units in a 10-minute window from the pacing timer alone. A unit may be an atomic pair. Actual reach, costs, claims, durable serial per-row work and shared native caps can lower throughput. Ordinary and expired/off cities keep the 5-tick gate.

At most 64 construction row credits after a real builder session and paid placement remains the same. No credit is itself an item. No change to quantities per physical work result or exact paid construction input.

Existing shared lab AutoSupply rate and material batches unchanged. Physical emerald barter moves existing inventory items; ordinary player trade prices, vault, tokens, XP, production SELL and contract configuration are untouched.

A reset archives discarded stock and does not drop it to anyone. Re-founding uses the ordinary initial lab grant for a fresh ID once. This is disposable admin-only lab state; no network redemption or transfer is modeled.
